zh.title: Windows 安装仓颉后找不到 cjc？检查 PATH 与 SDK 环境
zh.description: 从 PowerShell 的命令查找开始，区分 cjv 代理入口缺失、终端环境未刷新和 SDK 尚未安装，逐步恢复 cjc 与 cjpm。

en.title: Cangjie cjc not found on Windows: check PATH and the SDK
en.description: Diagnose missing cjv shims, a stale PowerShell environment and an uninstalled SDK. Find which compiler runs and restore cjc and cjpm step by step.

zh.title: 两个项目使用不同的仓颉 SDK：用 cjv 固定和切换版本
zh.description: 用 cangjie-sdk.toml 为两个项目固定不同的仓颉 SDK，检查版本来源，并在不修改团队配置的情况下临时测试另一套工具链。

en.title: Use different Cangjie SDK versions in two projects with cjv
en.description: Pin a Cangjie SDK per project with cangjie-sdk.toml, inspect the selected version and try another toolchain without changing your team's configuration.

zh.title: 在 GitHub Actions 中固定仓颉 SDK 版本并运行测试
zh.description: 将项目工具链文件接入 GitHub Actions，在 Ubuntu 作业中安装 cjv、校验版本、构建和测试仓颉项目，并按平台隔离缓存。

en.title: Pin the Cangjie SDK and run tests in GitHub Actions
en.description: Install cjv in an Ubuntu GitHub Actions job, validate the project's pinned SDK, build and test Cangjie code, and separate caches by platform.
